title: User Stories · Demo Stories · 9-Dimension Testing Matrix

user_stories.story: As a neurologist, I upload a patient's EEG so the AI gives a seizure-risk reading with SHAP evidence I can confirm or override before signing off.
As an EEG technician, I upload a recording so the system flags signal-quality and artifact issues before the neurologist reads it.
As an IRB/governance reviewer, I open the audit trail so every AI decision shows who/what/when, guardrail triggers, and fairness gate status.
As a patient, I am onboarded step-by-step (consent, demographics, history) and any clinician can ask the RAG chat about my records.
As the researcher, I run a cross-patient benchmark so I get a leakage-free accuracy number defensible to my committee.

demo_stories.title: Governed EEG read (30s)
demo_stories.script: Upload EEG → AI predicts seizure-risk + confidence → SHAP shows top features → neurologist confirms/overrides → decision audited.

demo_stories.title: Why oversight matters (45s)
demo_stories.script: Show in-sample 0.99 accuracy, then cross-patient CHB-MIT 0.70 (chb04=0.46) → prove leakage inflates numbers → human review is required.

demo_stories.title: Council of Agents (30s)
demo_stories.script: Ask a clinical query → Security gate → Planner → RAG → Eval → Review → Compliance → Audit, each step traced by request_id.
